title: Follow the gridworld download fallback
description: You inspect the artifact check and the recorded exception path.

steps.description: You import shutil and Path before trying the Colab files import. Archive creation and download share that protected block.
You create artifacts.zip and request its download when artifacts exists. Otherwise, the helper prints its missing-folder message.

steps.question: What message handles a download exception?
steps.answer: The except block prints Colab download helper not available in this environment, followed by the exception text.

steps.description: You see that fallback in the recording. The exception identifies google.colab.files.download as unavailable in code-viz.
